symptom: On ako/TestApp (11.14.0), `describe snippet WorkflowCommons.Snip_TaskDashboard_Header` with only dropDown2's emptyOptionText changed passed check, reported "Replaced snippet" and turned the stored DisabledDuringExecution false of dropDown2's onEnterEvent and onLeaveEvent NoActions into true; a layout rewrite did the same to an action button's NoAction. The issue's own page (ChangePasswordForm) and the other seven TestApp pages with stored-false NoActions already kept them
cause: The #721 L2 carry (backend carryNoActionExecution) pairs a classic widget's direct child action slots by widget name and runs in UpdatePage/UpdateSnippet only. A pluggable widget's slots are WidgetValues inside its Object — every one holds a Forms$NoAction, action property or not — so a changed widget rebuilt from the template (widgetobj builder writes true) was out of its reach; UpdateLayout never called it
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_pluggable_noaction_carry.go (pluggablePassthrough.carryNoActionExecution, called from buildPluggable when passStoredThrough declines); mdl/backend/modelsdk/layout_write.go (UpdateLayout)
fix: Pair the rebuilt widget's NoAction slots with the stored widget's by property key, each side resolved through its own Type (the template's property type IDs are not the stored ones), and copy the stored flag; a slot the statement fills with an action is not touched; object-list items are not paired. UpdateLayout calls the backend carry like the page and snippet writers
insight: The issue had been triaged 'partly fixed' on the page it named, and every page rewrite on TestApp kept the flag, so the remaining loss only showed up when the scan for stored false was widened from pages to snippets and layouts and grouped by widget kind: the hits under a pluggable widget's `Action` key were the ones no carry reached. Scan by property across all three document kinds before calling a carry complete. For a scratch run, copy the whole project directory: a copy of only the .mpr and mprcontents has no widgets/ folder, and check then reports MDL-WIDGET01 for combo box properties (clearable, emptyOptionText, lazyLoading, readOnlyStyle) the stored widget holds, which looks like a describe/check bug and is not
